reason: Regulatory capture signal: bill explicitly targets PACE provider burden reduction without specifying which regulations are lifted. PACE operates at Medicare-Medicaid intersection—classic zone for carve-outs that shift cost to federal programs while consolidating market access for established operators.
vectors: regulatory_capture: undefined 'burden reduction' on integrated care model serving dual-eligible population
fiscal_bleed: potential expansion of PACE reimbursement without offsetting constraints
entitlement_erosion: Medicaid/Medicare payment mechanics may be restructured to favor managed enrollment models
market_access_exploit: PACE already has high barriers to entry; lighter regulation could entrench incumbents while excluding new competitors
title: To amend titles XVIII and XIX of the Social Security Act to improve access to the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), to reduce regulatory burdens on PACE providers, and for other purposes.
